title: evaluation / Evaluate a local prompt
content: ## Evaluate a local prompt Inline tabular evaluation generates and scores responses in the same grid. Use it for a saved local prompt in Agent Builder when you want to change instructions or the selected model and inspect how those changes affect the same cases. To set up the prompt and its tools, follow [Work with local prompts](/docs/intelligentapps/agentbuilder.md#work-with-local-prompts). The empty grid shows where to import cases or add rows before generating responses and scoring them. ![Screenshot showing the empty local-prompt Evaluation grid with User Query, Response, and Manual columns and the Add an Empty Row action.](./images/evaluation/local-evaluation-grid.png) 1. Open the local prompt and select **Evaluation**. 2. Define any variables needed to run the prompt with different inputs. For example, the instruction Answer this question concisely: {{question}}. uses a dataset column named `question`. 3. Select **Import** to load the dataset, or add rows manually. Provide a value for each prompt variable and any additional evaluator columns. 4. Select the rows to test, then select **Run Response**. Review the generated responses. Use thumbs up and thumbs down to record manual feedback separately from automatic scores. 5. Select **Add Evaluation**. Choose the evaluators and, when required, a judge model. 6. Select the rows to score. From **Run Evaluation**, select **Run Evaluation Only** to score the current responses, or **Run Evaluation with Response** to rerun the selected rows before scoring. 7. Inspect the scores and explanations, including individual failures rather than only aggregate values. Mock custom-tool responses are not evidence that an external service ran. When testing live MCP tools, check the calls and returned data. Use the [tool setup guide](/docs/intelligentapps/tool-catalog.md) for runtime and authentication requirements. ### Compare saved local versions Keep the model, dataset, and evaluators consistent when comparing an instruction change. Save the local configuration and evaluation results you want to retain. 1. In the local prompt's **Evaluation** tab, expand the view to full screen if needed. 2. Select **Compare** and choose another saved version. 3. Compare the responses and evaluator scores for the same cases. 4. Exit comparison before changing data or running another evaluation. An evaluator score is specific to that metric. Do not treat different metrics as one universal overall score. For saving and selecting configurations, see [Agent Builder version management](/docs/intelligentapps/agentbuilder.md#save-drafts-and-versions).
